name: Polar Vision
body:
Your eyes grow accustomed to prolonged twilight.

Benefit(s): While outdoors in terrain covered by ice or snow, you gain low-light vision. If you already have low-light vision, you gain darkvision out to a range of 30 feet instead. If you already have darkvision, the range of your darkvision increases by 30 feet.
